mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 65 degrees with clear skies near the Verona Area High School. We are currently under a Waxing Gibbous moon, and the ISS will be visible tonight starting at 3:25 AM, rising over Mount Horeb and traveling high in the sky toward the Madison area near Home Depot. The temperature will dip to an overnight low of 58 degrees, with no rain expected.

The Verona Police Department has released a summary of their activity from August 17 to August 24. While it was a busy week, things were generally handled without major incident, covering a range of calls including traffic accidents, drug investigations, and wellness checks.

We have plenty going on, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow, you can enjoy trivia at Hop Haus Brewing, Lake Lou-ee, or Paddy Mac's. Looking further ahead, don't miss live music at Paddy Mac's on August 26, the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market on August 26, or music at Bailey's Run Vineyard on August 28.
On August 19, police responded to a motor vehicle crash at North Main Street and Bering Drive, where drivers were cited for issues including driving with a suspended license and failing to yield.

Today's flavor of the day is Dark Chocolate PB Crunch. Please be aware that the store is closing in less than sixty minutes, so plan accordingly if you want to grab a bowl before they finish their shift tonight.
